title: Retrieving a Word from an Encoding
statement: Let $J$ be a bit string and let $L$ be a list of bit strings. Encode $L$ by concatenating the pair encodings of its words with empty second components. Applying the word-retrieval procedure to the pair encoding of $J$ and this encoding of $L$ returns the word at index $|J|$ in $L$, or the empty word if that index is out of range.
